reconstructed_acceptance.comparison: The original Win98 executable exposes the same settings, three-page wizard, player-row menu, and name-finalization boundaries represented by the three typed reconstructions. This is an original/UI integration checkpoint, not proof that packed player/race records, localized resources, or every Win16 control message are complete.
